# Reading archive

The full bibliography behind the [reading map](../../docs/related_works.md). Open a topic below to browse references. Paper titles link to their sources; local PDF links work after you download the files. PDFs are not tracked in Git.

Recent starting points: [Sparks of Weight-Space Programming](https://rikiyat.github.io/blog/weight-space-programming/) and its [complete experiment logs](https://github.com/RikiyaT/lm_understand-logs).
